description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of next token prediction across training steps for two conditions, labeled Ex1 Accuracy and Ex2 Accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick marks at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 0.10 to 0.40 at intervals of 0.05. The "Ex1 Accuracy" is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers. It begins at Step 0 with a value slightly below 0.10, experiences a sharp increase to approximately 0.24 at the first marked step, and continues to rise steeply to roughly 0.39 near Step 7500. Following this point, the line exhibits a steady, gradual increase, ending at a peak value slightly above 0.40 at Step 60000. The "Ex2 Accuracy" is depicted by a solid cyan line with circular markers. It starts at the same initial value as Ex1, just below 0.10 at Step 0, and rises sharply to approximately 0.27 at the first marked step. The line then shows a more moderate increase to about 0.29 near Step 13000, followed by another distinct rise to approximately 0.36 near Step 19000. From there, it follows a steady, gradual upward trend, concluding at a value just below 0.39 at Step 60000.
